text: “Though there is no name, I think it is for your shepherd.” Boldwood looked then at the address:— To the New Shepherd, Weatherbury Farm, Near Casterbridge. “Oh—what a mistake!—it is not mine. Nor is it for my shepherd. It is for Miss Everdene’s. You had better take it on to him—Gabriel Oak—and say I opened it in mistake.” At this moment, on the ridge, up against the blazing sky, a figure was visible, like the black snuff in the midst of a candle-flame.
